LanguageData.MaidEmotionalSupport.stages.0.label: maid's emotional support
LanguageData.MaidEmotionalSupport.stages.0.descriptio: That maid always understands how I feel and gives me the most intimate comfort. I feel like the stress has disappeared.
LanguageData.ArtificialMaidMasterProtocol_Mood.stages: Under the protection of Outerrealm Tech's nano-array, I feel unprecedented peace of mind. The pain in my body disappeared in an instant, and my spirit was greatly invigorated.
LanguageData.ArtificialMaidAura_Mood.stages.0.label: maid's presence
LanguageData.ArtificialMaidAura_Mood.stages.0.descrip: The maid is right beside me. Her presence fills me with strength and confidence.
LanguageData.ArtificialMaidSubdued_Mood.stages.0.desc: Outerrealm Tech's control field has locked down all my functions: unable to act, unable to resist, only consciousness drifting in the darkness.
